title: Jamaica's Parishes
subject: Integrated Studies
description: Learn about Jamaica's 3 counties and 14 parishes — their names, capitals, and fun facts!
curriculum: Jamaica NSC Grade 2 - Integrated Studies (Social Studies)
source: NSC Practice — built from the official MOE Grade 2 curriculum
nscObjectives: Name the three counties of Jamaica
Name the fourteen parishes of Jamaica
Identify the capital town of each parish
Recognise important places in Jamaica's parishes

sections.title: The Three Counties
sections.description: Jamaica is divided into 3 big parts called counties: Cornwall, Middlesex, and Surrey.

questions.prompt: How many counties does Jamaica have?
questions.hint: Cornwall, Middlesex, and Surrey — count them!

questions.prompt: Select ALL of Jamaica's counties:
questions.hint: Kingston is a parish, not a county!

questions.prompt: Which county is in the WEST of Jamaica?
questions.hint: Cornwall is where the sun sets — in the west

questions.prompt: Which county is in the EAST of Jamaica?
questions.hint: Surrey is where the sun rises — in the east. Kingston is there!

questions.prompt: Which county is in the MIDDLE of Jamaica?
questions.hint: Its name even sounds like 'middle'!

questions.prompt: Kingston is in which county?
questions.hint: Kingston is in the east of Jamaica

sections.title: The 14 Parishes
sections.description: Jamaica's counties are divided into 14 smaller parts called parishes.

questions.prompt: How many parishes does Jamaica have?
questions.hint: Count them: Kingston, St. Andrew, St. Thomas, Portland... all the way to 14!

questions.prompt: Which parish is Jamaica's capital city in?
questions.hint: The capital city and the parish share the same name

questions.prompt: Select ALL the real Jamaican parishes:
questions.hint: Ocho Rios is a famous TOWN in St. Ann — not a parish

questions.prompt: Which of these is NOT a parish?
questions.hint: Montego Bay is a famous town — it is the capital of St. James parish

questions.prompt: Which is the SMALLEST parish in Jamaica?
questions.hint: It's small in size but very important — it holds our capital city!

questions.prompt: Which is the LARGEST parish in Jamaica?
questions.hint: It's called the 'Garden Parish' and it's the biggest!

questions.prompt: Select ALL the parishes that start with 'St.':
questions.hint: Look for the little 'St.' at the front of the name

questions.prompt: Type the name of the parish where YOU would find Jamaica's capital city:
questions.hint: It starts with 'K' — the same name as our capital city

sections.title: Parish Capitals
sections.description: Every parish has a capital town. Let's learn some of them!

questions.prompt: Match each parish to its capital town:
questions.hint: Montego Bay is by the sea in the northwest; Spanish Town is old; Mandeville is cool and hilly

questions.prompt: Match each parish to its capital town:
questions.hint: Port Antonio and Portland both start with 'Port'!

questions.prompt: What is the capital of St. Andrew?
questions.hint: Long ago, travellers rested halfway at a big cotton tree there

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Clarendon?
questions.hint: It has the word 'May' in it

questions.prompt: What is the capital of St. Elizabeth?
questions.hint: It's named after a river with dark water

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Westmoreland?
questions.hint: Its name means 'plain by the sea' — it's a long name!

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Trelawny?
questions.hint: Usain Bolt was born near this historic town!

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Hanover?
questions.hint: Say it 'Lucy' — a small town by the sea in the northwest

sections.title: Parish Fun Facts
sections.description: Jamaica's parishes are full of amazing places. How many do you know?

questions.prompt: Dunn's River Falls, the famous waterfall, is in which parish?
questions.hint: It's near the town of Ocho Rios in the Garden Parish

questions.prompt: The Blue Mountains, Jamaica's tallest mountains, are between Portland and which parish?
questions.hint: Both parishes are in the east, in the county of Surrey

questions.prompt: Spanish Town in St. Catherine is special because it was once Jamaica's ___.
questions.hint: Before Kingston, this old town was the capital!

questions.prompt: Many visitors fly to Montego Bay for holidays. It is the capital of which parish?
questions.hint: Mo-Bay is in the northwest, in the county of Cornwall

questions.prompt: St. Ann is called the 'Garden Parish'. Why do you think that is?
options: It is full of beautiful green plants and flowers
questions.correct: It is full of beautiful green plants and flowers
questions.hint: Gardens are full of green growing things!

questions.prompt: Sprinter Usain Bolt, the fastest man ever, was born in which parish?
questions.hint: Its capital is Falmouth — and its runners are FAST!
